headline_marked: Tawfique Nawaz, [[husband of Dipu Moni, dies]] at 76
headline: Tawfique Nawaz, husband of Dipu Moni, dies at 76
summary: The Supreme Court lawyer passed away at Continental Hospital in Dhaka after battling kidney and liver complications.
details: Tawfique Nawaz, the husband of former minister and Awami League leader Dipu Moni, has passed away at the age of 76.
He died on Tuesday night at 10:27 PM at the Continental Hospital in Gulshan, Dhaka, following a prolonged illness.
According to lawyer Gazi Faisal Islam, Nawaz had been suffering from kidney and liver complications for a long time and was admitted to the hospital a few days ago as his condition deteriorated.
Dipu Moni is currently detained in Munshiganj District Jail, facing multiple cases related to killings during the July uprising.
Lawyer Gazi Faisal Islam stated that an application for parole will be submitted to the Munshiganj Deputy Commissioner on Wednesday morning to allow her to attend her husband's funeral.
Decisions regarding the funeral prayers and burial will be made by family members following further discussion.

Dipu Moni is currently detained in Munshiganj District Jail, facing multiple cases related to killings during the July uprising.

Lawyer Gazi Faisal Islam stated that an application for parole will be submitted to the Munshiganj Deputy Commissioner on Wednesday morning to allow her to attend her husband's funeral.

Decisions regarding the funeral prayers and burial will be made by family members following further discussion.

headline_marked: 14 buses launched: [[BRTC starts women-only ‘Pink Bus’ service]] in 5 cities
headline: 14 buses launched: BRTC starts women-only ‘Pink Bus’ service in 5 cities
summary: The service features 15 women drivers and 24 conductors to provide safer and more comfortable public transport for women.
details: The Bangladesh Road Transport Corporation (BRTC) has launched a women-only "Pink Bus" service. A total of 14 buses, including 13 double-deckers and one single-decker, are now operational across Dhaka, Narayanganj, Gazipur, Bogura, and Chattogram.
caption:
Women are taking the wheel! BRTC launches a women-only 'Pink Bus' service across five cities.

The Bangladesh Road Transport Corporation (BRTC) has launched a women-only "Pink Bus" service. A total of 14 buses, including 13 double-deckers and one single-decker, are now operational across Dhaka, Narayanganj, Gazipur, Bogura, and Chattogram.
